mapper.select: SELECT na.id, na.notice_id, na.file_id, f.original_name AS file_name, f.size AS byte_size, na.sort_order, na.created_at FROM tb_notice_attachments na JOIN tb_files f ON f.id = na.file_id WHERE na.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND na.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY na.sort_order ASC, na.created_at ASC, na.id ASC
